items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua suffered believed-minor calf injury exiting Thursday practice (limited); status up in the air/uncertain for Sunday vs Raiders despite tests showing not significant.
items.why: Exited practice early Thursday; Rapoport post-tests: minor but availability unclear; McVay update pending Friday.
items.implication: Game-time decision risk; if out, heavy TE/WR2 target concentration with Adams already IR.
items.opportunity: If out: elevated targets for remaining Rams pass-catchers (Higbee etc.); if in: monitor snap/route limits.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered non-contact knee injury late in TNF win vs Patriots, carted off; coach Ben Johnson said it 'didn't look very good'; already ruled out with more tests Friday. Rapoport: Bears appear to have lost him.
items.why: Non-contact knee buckle, carted, coach negative comments, tests ongoing but ruled out immediately.
items.implication: Significant absence opens TE/WR opportunity in Bears offense; reduces 2/3-TE sets.
items.opportunity: Higher route/target share for remaining TEs and WRs in single-TE looks.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played just 21% of snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.why: Sharp drop in snap share last 3 weeks; clear reduced role.
items.implication: Sit/fade in fantasy until snap share rebounds; handcuff or committee risk elevated.
items.opportunity: Teammate RBs absorbing work; monitor for any injury or scheme shift reverse.

items.text: Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-TE sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; fewer multi-TE sets freer snaps/routes for Burden.
items.implication: Boost to WR2/flex upside ROS and immediately; monitor for expanded role.
items.opportunity: Increased route share and targets if 12-personnel drops.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to sell pre-deadline after GM firing. Taylor himself not thinking about it ahead of Vikings matchup.
items.why: Source to ESPN: multi-team interest post-Ballard firing; Colts 2-4 may consider offers by Nov 10 deadline.
items.implication: Hold value high short-term; potential landing spot upgrade or disruption if dealt; monitor for handcuff/backup elevation.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender: boost; Colts side: next RB up in volume.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs with hamstring; official report.
items.implication: Elevated miss risk for Week 7; check Friday designation. Boosts other KC WRs/TE if out.
items.opportunity: If out: more targets for Worthy/others in Chiefs passing game.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present/limited Thursday practice (ankle); limp from Wednesday gone per beats. Trending up for Week 7.
items.why: Returned to practice, improved movement, no limp.
items.implication: Likely to play; QB1 upside if cleared fully. Monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Full passing/rushing role expected if active.

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play vs Dallas MNF (RB15 rank); very efficient in two full games played this season. Dallas one of best fantasy matchups for RBs. Returned to practice (hamstring).
items.why: Practice return + 'in line' per Berry; efficiency prior + elite matchup.
items.implication: Startable RB2/flex with upside; monitor final snaps but positive trajectory.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full workload likely vs soft Dallas run D.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Thursday report); previously sat Wednesday, not ruled out for Week 7.
items.why: Returned after Wednesday sit; Jets report positive.
items.implication: Trending toward active; volume RB if full go vs MIA.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings/facility, lifting, medical (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers—poor, OL mess too. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS pod.
items.why: Progress to non-practice activities; backups inefficient EPA supports Jacobs value when back.
items.implication: Positive for near-term return; still workload/role questions post-layoff. Prefer Jacobs over backups.
items.opportunity: Full workload likely upon clearance given backup inefficiency.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on layoff concerns.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage; 33% target share and 97% routes Week 6 despite drops—buying the volume.
items.why: Elite route/target share returning; soft Bears matchup for yards; buy low post-drops.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; volume floor high.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions gift to pass-catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO (big workload friendly matchup), Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR.
items.why: Usage + soft matchups (Lions/Bears/TB/CAR defenses leak); consistent workloads for RBs.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kraft TE upside, RBs volume plays.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (nasty matchup/role), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.why: Tough matchups, reduced roles/shares, or post-injury workload questions.
items.implication: Sit/fade this week; Kelce/Jacobs especially volatile.
items.conflict: Levitan more constructive on Jacobs facility progress vs Berry hate.
